Definition: properly, cut out (or hollow), i.e. (by implication) a pocket
BiblicalUsage: Chariyt is a pocket, a bag, a purse, and it appears twice, both times holding what men value. Naaman bound two talents of silver in two bags and laid them on his servants, and Isaiah lists the crisping pins among the finery of the daughters of Zion.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is small and the lesson is plain: what a man carries in his pocket shows what he trusts.
